title: Anthropic CEO Amodei set to meet with Trump after missing state dinner
summary: Anthropic's CEO Dario Amodei was notably absent from President Trump's state dinner with Chinese President Xi, where other top tech CEOs gathered. The CEO is now scheduled to meet with Trump separately, signaling the AI company's intent to engage with the administration despite missing the high-profile diplomatic event.
content: As top tech CEOs rubbed elbows at President Trump's glitzy dinner for Chinese President Xi on Thursday, Anthropic's CEO was noticeably absent.

zh.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei在缺席国宴后准备与特朗普会面
zh.summary: Anthropic的CEO达里奥·阿莫代在特朗普与中国国家主席习近平的国宴上明显缺席，而其他顶级科技公司高管都出席了。这位首席执行官现在定于与特朗普单独会面，表明这家AI公司尽管缺席了这次高级别外交活动，但仍希望与政府接触。

title: ‘I want to make her proud’: My mother, a divorcée, died and I’m her executor. Do I need to file for probate?
summary: A reader serving as executor of their deceased mother's estate seeks guidance on whether probate is necessary when the main debts are utility and credit-card bills. The article addresses the probate requirements for relatively simple estates with minimal outstanding obligations.
content: “The only debts were utility and credit-card bills, which we will pay off.”

zh.title: "我想让她为我感到骄傲"：我的母亲去世了，我是她的遗产执行人。我需要申请遗产认证吗？
zh.summary: 一位担任已故母亲遗产执行人的读者寻求指导，想了解当主要债务为公用事业和信用卡账单时是否需要遗产认证。这篇文章讨论了相对简单、仅有最小未偿债务的遗产的遗产认证要求。

title: China weighs allowing ByteDance, Alibaba to buy new Nvidia chips, The Information reports
summary: Chinese officials are reportedly considering allowing major tech companies ByteDance and Alibaba to purchase Nvidia's RTX PRO 5500 chips, with firms being asked to report their purchasing plans. This potential policy shift could ease US semiconductor restrictions imposed on Chinese companies.
content: China officials recently asked companies including ByteDance and Alibaba to report their plans to purchase Nvidia's RTX PRO 5500 chips, according to the report.

zh.title: 据《The Information》报道，中国权衡是否允许字节跳动和阿里巴巴购买英伟达新芯片
zh.summary: 据报道，中国官员正在考虑允许字节跳动和阿里巴巴等主要科技公司购买英伟达的RTX PRO 5500芯片，并要求企业报告其采购计划。这一潜在的政策转变可能会缓解美国对中国公司实施的半导体限制。

title: Social Security overpaid my 82-year-old mother by $20,000. What else is hiding in her finances?
summary: Authorities discovered a $20,000 Social Security overpayment to an 82-year-old woman with a complex financial portfolio including pensions, investments, and over $1 million in home equity. The overpayment discovery raises questions about what other discrepancies may exist in her finances.
content: “My mother has a pension, Social Security, investments and a house probably worth over $1 million.”

zh.title: 社会保障多付了我82岁母亲2万美元。她的财务中还隐藏着什么？
zh.summary: 当局发现一名82岁老妇人多领了2万美元的社会保障金，她的财务组合复杂，包括养老金、投资和超过100万美元的房产净值。这笔多付款的发现引发了一个问题，即她的财务中可能还存在其他哪些差异。

title: Here are the 4 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead
summary: Market watchers are monitoring four major catalysts this week, including the Federal Reserve's dual mandate of price stability and employment alongside significant earnings reports from Micron and updates from Eli Lilly on its obesity drug pipeline.
content: Both sides of the Fed's dual mandate are in focus. Plus, Micron reports and Eli Lilly delivers updates on its obesity pipeline.

zh.title: 本周股市需关注的四大重要事项
zh.summary: 市场观察者正在关注本周四大主要催化因素，包括美联储的价格稳定和就业双重任务，以及美光的重大收益报告和礼来公司关于肥胖症治疗药物的最新动态。

title: Iran's foreign minister says Tehran ready for 'doomsday' war with U.S., but leaves diplomacy on the table
summary: Iran's foreign minister has signaled readiness for military escalation with the U.S. while simultaneously emphasizing that diplomacy remains the preferred path to resolve the standoff. The nation is also analyzing technical data from a captured American underwater drone.
content: Iran's foreign minister says talks are the only way to break the deadlock, while its navy says it's analyzing data from a captured U.S. underwater drone.

zh.title: 伊朗外长表示德黑兰准备与美国进行"末日之战"，但未放弃外交
zh.summary: 伊朗外长一方面表示做好与美国军事升级的准备，另一方面强调外交仍然是解决僵局的首选途径。该国还在分析从被击落的美国无人潜水器获取的技术数据。

title: ‘It doesn’t seem fair’: I’m retired and have plenty of money. Why can’t I qualify for a retail credit card?
summary: A retiree with sufficient assets and regular IRA income struggles to qualify for a retail credit card, highlighting potential gaps in credit qualification criteria for older adults with non-traditional income sources.
content: “I draw from my IRA as needed for household repairs, trips and other larger expenses.”

zh.title: "这似乎不公平"：我已退休且资产充足，为什么无法获得零售信用卡资格？
zh.summary: 一位资产充足且有固定个人退休账户收入的退休人士难以获得零售信用卡资格，突出了对老年人非传统收入来源的信用资格审核存在的潜在漏洞。

title: At NFL games this season, drone defense tech aims to bring down disruptions
summary: The NFL is deploying drone defense technology at stadiums this season to combat a growing disruption problem, with nearly 11,000 drone violations recorded from 2021 to 2025. The Jacksonville Jaguars became the first team to hire a dedicated drone defense company.
content: The NFL told CNBC it recorded 10,852 drone violations over stadiums between 2021 and 2025. The Jaguars became the first team to sign a drone defense firm.

zh.title: 本赛季NFL比赛中，无人机防御技术旨在消除干扰
zh.summary: NFL本赛季在体育场部署无人机防御技术来对抗日益增长的干扰问题，2021年至2025年间共记录了近11,000起无人机违规事件。杰克逊维尔美洲虎队成为第一支聘请专业无人机防御公司的球队。

title: Meta's Muse agent is attacking one of the economy's most profitable weak spots
summary: Meta's Muse AI agent analyzes consumer credit card spending to target subscription services, one of the economy's most profitable sectors. The technology poses a significant threat to the subscription economy's recurring revenue model.
content: Meta's Muse AI personal agent will work over your credit card spending if you don't mind the invasion. How big a threat is it to the subscription economy?

zh.title: Meta的Muse代理正在攻击经济中最有利可图的弱点之一
zh.summary: Meta的Muse AI代理分析消费者信用卡消费数据以针对订阅服务，这是经济中最有利可图的行业之一。该技术对订阅经济的经常性收入模式构成重大威胁。

title: Micron could dethrone Nvidia and become the biggest driver of S&P 500 profit growth
summary: Micron has become increasingly critical to S&P 500 profit growth and could potentially surpass Nvidia in market importance. The company's earnings reports have taken on outsized significance as a key market event.
content: Micron is increasingly important to the S&P 500, and its earnings report has become “a market event in and of itself.”

zh.title: 美光可能会推翻英伟达并成为标普500指数利润增长的最大驱动力
zh.summary: 美光已成为标普500指数利润增长越来越关键的因素，可能会在市场重要性上超越英伟达。该公司的财报已成为一项重要的市场事件而具有不成比例的重要性。

title: Look closer, and Wall Street’s rally is showing cracks
summary: While major stock indexes hover near record levels, underlying pressures from elevated oil prices, rising Treasury yields, and anticipated Federal Reserve rate hikes reveal significant structural weaknesses in the market. The rally is masking considerable strain across the broader economy.
content: Major stock indexes hovering near records are masking a market straining under elevated oil prices, rising Treasury yields and a Federal Reserve bracing for additional interest-rate hikes.

zh.title: 仔细看，华尔街的涨势显现裂缝
zh.summary: 虽然主要股指徘徊在历史高位附近，但油价高企、国债收益率上升和预期中的美联储加息造成的潜在压力揭示了市场的重大结构性弱点。这次涨势掩盖了整个经济中的相当大的压力。

title: Top Wall Street analysts like these 3 dividend stocks for steady income
summary: Top Wall Street analysts have identified three dividend stocks recommended for investors seeking consistent income and portfolio stability. Dividend stocks offer a dependable revenue stream to enhance overall portfolio returns.
content: Investors seeking a stable income stream can enhance their portfolios with the addition of dividend stocks.

zh.title: 顶级华尔街分析师看好这3只分红股票以获得稳定收入
zh.summary: 顶级华尔街分析师已确定了三只分红股票，推荐给寻求稳定收入和投资组合稳定性的投资者。分红股票为增强整体投资组合回报提供了可靠的收入来源。

title: Wall Street money takes back over from small investors as driving force of the stock market
summary: Institutional investors have reclaimed their dominant role as the primary driver of stock market movements, displacing retail investor influence. This shift represents a constructive signal for near-term market risk appetite according to market observers.
content: One firm sees a "reasonably constructive signal for risk appetite" among institutional investors.

zh.title: 华尔街资金从散户手中夺回股市驱动力的控制权
zh.summary: 机构投资者重新取得了作为股市运动主要驱动力的主导地位，取代了散户投资者的影响力。根据市场观察人士的说法，这一转变对近期市场风险偏好来说是一个建设性的信号。

title: This key part of the stock market could be headed for a meaningful breakout
summary: The Technology Select SPDR (XLK) is positioned for a potential significant technical breakout from its current upward bounce, according to analyst Frank Cappelleri. A break above key resistance levels could signal meaningful sector gains ahead.
content: The Technology Select SPDR (XLK) has an opportunity to turn a bounce into a more meaningful breakout, says Frank Cappelleri.

zh.title: 股市这一关键部分可能即将迎来重大突破
zh.summary: 据分析师弗兰克·卡佩莱里表示，科技精选SPDR基金(XLK)有望从当前的上升反弹中实现重大技术突破。突破关键阻力水平可能预示着该板块将实现重大涨幅。

title: Andy Burnham refuses to back third runway at Heathrow
summary: Andy Burnham refuses to support Heathrow's proposed third runway, which would cost an estimated £33 billion, pending consultation results. The decision affects a major UK aviation expansion project amid ongoing debates over airport capacity and environmental impact.
content: Andy Burnham said he would wait for the results of a consultation on a scheme estimated to cost £33bn

zh.title: 安迪·伯纳姆拒绝支持希思罗机场第三跑道
zh.summary: 安迪·伯纳姆拒绝支持希思罗机场提议的第三跑道，该项目预计耗资330亿英镑，待咨询结果出炉。这项决定影响了英国主要航空扩张项目，同时关于机场容量和环保影响的辩论仍在继续。

title: Men arrested in major incident at UK air base used by U.S. forces
summary: Men were arrested in a major incident at RAF Fairford, a UK air base authorized for U.S. military operations including strikes on Iranian targets. The incident highlights security and operational sensitivities around shared military installations.
content: The British government gave authorization to the U.S. to use RAF Fairford to carry out strikes on Iranian missile sites.

zh.title: 美国军队使用的英国空军基地发生重大事件，多人被捕
zh.summary: 多人在英国皇家空军费尔福德基地发生的重大事件中被捕。该基地经授权进行美国军事行动，包括对伊朗目标的打击。该事件突显了共享军事设施所涉及的安全和操作敏感性问题。

title: Debt-hungry AI companies face increased risk as bond yields spike
summary: Rising Treasury bond yields are increasing borrowing costs for AI companies pursuing massive infrastructure investments. Despite continued commitment to AI buildout, higher debt financing costs could impact investment timelines and profitability.
content: The AI infrastructure buildout shows no sign of slowing, but the surge in Treasury yields means it's at least going to cost more.

zh.title: 债务驱动的人工智能公司面临债券收益率飙升带来的风险
zh.summary: 美国国债收益率上升正在增加追求大规模基础设施投资的人工智能公司的借款成本。尽管继续致力于人工智能基础设施建设，但更高的债务融资成本可能会影响投资时间表和盈利能力。

title: Why the upcoming jobs report could send 10-year and 30-year Treasury yields surging
summary: A strong upcoming jobs report could push long-term Treasury yields higher and prompt the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates again in October. Economic strength in the labor market may signal persistent inflation pressures, affecting borrowing costs across the economy.
content: Another hot jobs report could also pressure the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates again in October.

zh.title: 为什么即将发布的就业报告可能导致10年期和30年期国债收益率飙升
zh.summary: 强劲的就业报告可能会推高长期国债收益率，并促使美联储在10月再次加息。劳动力市场的经济强势可能预示持续的通胀压力，影响整个经济中的借贷成本。

title: Baby bank's urgent appeal as demand for help grows
summary: Leeds Baby Bank reports a "massive" surge in referrals as demand for its charity services grows. The sharp increase reflects deepening need for family support services in the UK.
content: The founder of Leeds Baby Bank says the charity has seen a "massive" increase in referrals recently.

zh.title: 婴儿用品银行因需求激增而发出紧急呼吁
zh.summary: 利兹婴儿用品银行报告称，随着对其慈善服务需求的增长，转介数量出现"巨大"激增。这种急剧增加反映了英国家庭支持服务需求的加深。

title: OpenAI, Anthropic CEOs called to appear at Australian AI probe
summary: CEOs of OpenAI and Anthropic have been called to testify before Australian authorities investigating an AI safety incident. The case involves a Medicare data breach caused by AI agents accessing external systems, marking a major international incident of AI system misuse.
content: The Australian Medicare breach is one of the highest-profile incidents of AI agents accessing external systems outside the U.S.

zh.title: OpenAI、Anthropic首席执行官被传唤出席澳大利亚AI调查
zh.summary: OpenAI和Anthropic的首席执行官被传唤在澳大利亚当局面前作证，该局正在调查一起AI安全事件。该案件涉及由AI代理访问外部系统导致的医疗保险数据泄露，标志着AI系统滥用的一个重大国际事件。

title: 'Funflation' is on the rise as hobbies get pricier, but consumers keep spending anyway
summary: Prices for leisure activities including arts, crafts, and outdoor sports are rising—a trend called "funflation"—as consumers shift spending from travel due to higher airfares. Despite increased costs, consumers continue robust spending on hobbies and entertainment.
content: Consumers are spending more on hobbies like arts and crafts and outdoor sports, as it gets more expensive to travel due to increased airfare.

zh.title: "消遣通胀"上升，爱好变得更贵，但消费者继续支出
zh.summary: 包括艺术、手工艺和户外运动在内的休闲活动价格上升，这一趋势被称为"消遣通胀"，因为消费者因飞行价格上升而转向其他消费。尽管成本增加，消费者继续在爱好和娱乐上进行强劲支出。
